or physics or anything like that,
having two vehicles jump the curb and hit things

to anecdotally realize that we have some problems
with our street design.

Nobody here in the city administration or employee was here.
This has been going on since the 1950s.

past the time to begin the same incremental changes
that made our streets more dangerous
to make our streets more safe.

being out there.

There's 40,000 people a year in this country
that are killed in traffic crashes.

being around to make somebody stop speeding or not speed.
We should design streets that do not physically allow you
